defense_news.title: French artillery regiment reorganizes guns to survive drone threats
defense_news.summary: A French artillery formation is trialing a new organization of its gun units and support procedures, prompted by drone lessons from the war in Ukraine.

defense_news.title: New Zealand, Australia sign pact to deepen naval cooperation
defense_news.summary: The New Zealand and Australian navies signed “Plan Tasman” this month, formalizing a blueprint for integrating the two neighboring sea services.

defense_news.title: Russia raises 2027 military spending by 27%, budget documents show
defense_news.summary: Russia plans to spend 17.1 trillion roubles, or $202 billion, on defense in 2027, a 27% increase.

defense_news.title: EU nails down five defense priority areas to channel common spending
defense_news.summary: Drones, counter-drone tech, air defense, seabed defense and eastern flank protection top the EU's list of desired capability areas.
